statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
CPT code 93271 (cardiac event monitoring) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary to evaluate for arrhythmic causes of transient cerebral ischemic events
The cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary to guide anticoagulation management for atrial fibrillation
